basic_details.job_title: CSIR CFTRI Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in for Project Assistant I, Project Associate I Posts
basic_details.post_name: Project Assistant I and Project Associate I

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 35 years for Project Assistant – I (PA-I). The age of candidates will be treated on the date of the walk-in interview.

qualification.details: Desirable Qualification/Experience: Experience in fermented probiotics, postbiotics, gut microbiota studies will be preferred.

vacancy_details.Stipend & HRA: (a) Rs. 31,000/- plus HRA for those candidates who have qualified National Eligibility Tests (CSIR-UGC NET, GATE etc.)(b) Rs. 25,000/- plus HRA for others who do not fall under (a) above

post_wise_breakdown.stipend_hra: (a) Rs. 31,000/- plus HRA for those candidates who have qualified National Eligibility Tests (CSIR-UGC NET, GATE etc.)(b) Rs. 25,000/- plus HRA for others who do not fall under (a) above

category_wise_vacancy.Stipend & HRA: (a) Rs. 31,000/- plus HRA for those candidates who have qualified National Eligibility Tests (CSIR-UGC NET, GATE etc.)(b) Rs. 25,000/- plus HRA for others who do not fall under (a) above

salary_details.project associate – i (pat-i): Rs. 31,000/- plus HRA (for NET/GATE qualified) or Rs. 25,000/- plus HRA (for others) per month

selection_process: Selections are made through a walk-in interview. In the event of a large number of applications
the duly constituted committee will adopt criteria to shortlist candidates through percentage of marks obtained in the essential qualification
or any other methodology deemed fit.
how_to_apply: Download the application form (Annexure-I) from the official website or notification PDF.
Fill out the application form carefully with all required details.
Attend the walk-in interview on 16.10.2026 at the designated reporting time.
Carry original and self-attested copies of all certificates and testimonials.
Bring a valid identity proof (Voter ID card, PAN Card, Driving License, Passport, or Aadhaar Card).
Bring one passport-size photograph along with the original certificates.
important_instructions: No candidate will be allowed to appear in the interview without original certificates. No TA/DA will be given to candidates for attending the interview. The total period of engagement of project personnel across CSIR labs cumulatively shall not exceed 06 years. Applicants who have completed the total tenure of 6 years in any CSIR lab/institute as project staff are NOT ELIGIBLE to apply. Selected candidates must submit one month’s prior notice or deposit one month’s stipend in lieu if they wish to discontinue before tenure completion. Canvassing in any form will be treated as a disqualification. The engagement is initially for a period up to March 2027 and may be extendable up to October 2027 based on requirements and project duration.

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selections are made through a walk-in interview. In the event of a large number of applications, the duly constituted committee will adopt criteria to shortlist candidates through percentage of marks obtained in the essential qualification, higher educational qualifications, desirable qualification/experience, or any other methodology deemed fit.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR CFTRI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form (Annexure-I) from the official website or notification PDF. Fill out the application form carefully with all required details. Attend the walk-in interview on 16.10.2026 at the designated reporting time. Carry original and self-attested copies of all certificates and testimonials. Bring a valid identity proof (Voter ID card, PAN Card, Driving License, Passport, or Aadhaar Card). Bring one passport-size photograph along with the original certificates.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Original and self-attested copies of all educational and experience certificates/testimonials Valid identity proof (Voter ID card, PAN Card, Driving License, Passport, or Aadhaar Card) One passport-size photograph Caste/category certificate in the proper format issued by the Appropriate Authority (if applicable) No Objection Certificate (Annexure-II) if higher degree is ongoing under AcSIR or a university with a CSIR MoU

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No candidate will be allowed to appear in the interview without original certificates. No TA/DA will be given to candidates for attending the interview. The total period of engagement of project personnel across CSIR labs cumulatively shall not exceed 06 years. Applicants who have completed the total tenure of 6 years in any CSIR lab/institute as project staff are NOT ELIGIBLE to apply. Selected candidates must submit one month’s prior notice or deposit one month’s stipend in lieu if they wish to discontinue before tenure completion. Canvassing in any form will be treated as a disqualification. The engagement is initially for a period up to March 2027 and may be extendable up to October 2027 based on requirements and project duration.

faq.question: Q1. What is CSIR CFTRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: CSIR CFTRI Recruitment 2026 is a walk-in interview notification for engaging Project Assistant - I and Project Associate - I purely on a temporary basis for project GAP000684.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are notified under CSIR CFTRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been notified: 1 for Project Assistant – I and 1 for Project Associate – I.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date for CSIR CFTRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 16 October 2026 (Friday) at CSIR-CFTRI, Mysuru.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification for Project Assistant – I?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. in Microbiology or equivalent from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Project Associate – I?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M.Sc. in Microbiology or equivalent from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q6. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interviews?
faq.answer: The reporting time is 9.00 AM to 9.30 AM for Project Assistant – I, and 1.30 PM to 2.00 PM for Project Associate – I on 16.10.2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for CSIR CFTRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the stipend offered for Project Associate – I?
faq.answer: It is Rs. 31,000/- plus HRA for candidates qualified in National Eligibility Tests (CSIR-UGC NET, GATE, etc.), and Rs. 25,000/- plus HRA for others.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the reporting venue for the interview?
faq.answer: The venue is CSIR-CFTRI, Opp. Railway Museum, Mysuru-570020.
